name: GitHub CLI 2.105.0
body:
## Security

Upgrade soon: this release fixes CVE-2099-31337.

## Upgrading

BREAKING CHANGE: `pager` is now read from the user configuration only, a repository-level value is ignored.

## What's Changed

* Show the check name in `pr checks --watch`, by @rosa-v in #9502
* Fix the completion of `workflow run` in fish, by @marisol-t in #9507

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cli/cli/compare/v2.104.0...v2.105.0

name: GitHub CLI 2.104.0-rc.1
body:
## BREAKING CHANGES

* `pr list --json` no longer returns the deprecated `reviewRequests.login` field; read `reviewRequests.slug` instead.
* The minimum supported Git version is now 2.40.

## What's Changed

* Add `--no-maintainer-edit` to `pr edit`, by @rosa-v in #9455
* Speed up `repo clone` for large monorepos, by @kenji-a in #9461

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cli/cli/compare/v2.103.3...v2.104.0-rc.1

name: GitHub CLI 2.103.2
body:
## What's Changed

* Fix the `--limit` flag of `issue list` when combined with `--search`, by @kenji-a in #9371
* Document `GH_PROMPT_DISABLED` in the environment help, by @rosa-v in #9376
* Bump the bundled certificates, by @marisol-t in #9380

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cli/cli/compare/v2.103.1...v2.103.2
